messages:
Maya: quick bakeoff notes from this morning's GPTQ sweep across Llama / Mistral / Qwen. dropping raw numbers + a couple deploy profile recs. feedback? :eyes:

Sven: nice, thanks. do we have per-task deltas or just avg ppl/perf?

Maya: per-task. focused on Lambada (longform), MMLU, HellaSwag, PIQA, and WinoGrande. also a short throughput run (bsz 1/8, seq 2048) on A100 and 80GB H100.

Priya: can you paste the command you used for the eval harness? makes replication easier.

Maya: sure — run used the internal eval runner w/ GPTQ-backed weights and our quant profiles: 

```
./eval_runner --model-path /mnt/models/gptq/qwen-7b-gptq --tasks lambada,mmlu,hellaswag,piqa,winogrande --seq-len 2048 --batch 1 --quant=gptq --gptq-config configs/qwen-7b/gptq.toml --out /tmp/qwen-gptq.json
```

Sven: thanks. what variants tested? GPTQ only? AWQ? int8?

Maya: tested GPTQ (per-channel 4-bit/8-bit variants), AWQ INT8, and a baseline FP16. For Llama & Mistral we also tested a small FP8 path on H100 (experimental) — will call that fp8-exp.

eval-bot: [auto] recorded metrics: lambada_ppl, mmlu_acc, hellaswag_acc, piqa_acc, winogrande_acc, tokens/sec (bsz1/seq2048). artifacts uploaded to s3://redwood-evals/1807654321/

Omar: top-line summary?

Maya: TL;DR: GPTQ 4-bit keeps within 1-2% absolute on most classification tasks for Llama-2-13b and Qwen-7b; Mistral-7b has a slightly larger drop (~3.5% on HellaSwag). AWQ int8 is better for throughput but occasionally regresses more on reasoning (Lambada PPL +8-12%). FP8-exp on H100 shows promise for latency but is noisy across seeds.

Lee: numbers? small table would help (even short).

Maya: pasted condensed numbers below (baseline = FP16). each line: model | quant | lambada_ppl_delta | mmlu_delta | hellaswag_delta | piqa_delta | winogrande_delta | tokens_sec_A100 | tokens_sec_H100

Maya: 
Llama-2-13b | gptq-4 | +1.1% | -0.6% | +0.8% | -0.2% | +0.4% | 320 tok/s | 690 tok/s
Qwen-7b    | gptq-4 | +0.9% | -0.4% | +1.5% | -0.1% | +0.2% | 410 tok/s | 820 tok/s
Mistral-7b  | gptq-4 | +2.5% | -1.2% | +3.5% | -0.7% | +0.6% | 380 tok/s | 760 tok/s
Qwen-7b    | awq-int8 | +8.3% | -1.9% | +2.9% | +0.5% | +1.0% | 980 tok/s | 1900 tok/s
Llama-2-13b| fp8-exp  | +0.7% | -0.3% | +1.2% | +0.1% | +0.3% | 450 tok/s | 1400 tok/s

Sven: notable that AWQ int8 throughput is huge — 2x+ — but lambada ppl +8% is concerning for generative features.

Priya: do we have signficant variance across seeds for fp8-exp?

Maya: yes, fp8-exp varied ~0.5-1.8% on the classification tasks across 3 seeds. recommend more stable quant kernels before putting in prod.

Omar: memory & binary sizes?

Maya: binary/weight footprint: GPTQ-4 ~ 0.55x FP16 size; AWQ-int8 ~0.45x; FP8-exp ~0.5x due to special metadata. Peak GPU memory during inference (seq2048/bsz1): GPTQ-4 on A100 ~48GB for Llama-13b; AWQ-int8 ~36GB; FP8-exp ~40GB.

Lee: any regression patterns by task? e.g., reasoning vs commonsense?

Maya: good call — regressions concentrate on long-context generative PPL (Lambada) and on multi-hop reasoning items in MMLU. Commonsense (PIQA / Winogrande) is fairly robust to GPTQ. Mistral seems more sensitive in HellaSwag (commonsense inference) which was unexpected.

Sven: could that be tokenizer mismatch or special token handling?

Maya: we double-checked tokenization; mismatches not the cause. hypothesis: attention kernel differences + layernorm ordering in Mistral interacts poorly with per-channel GPTQ calibration on some heads. filing an experimental follow-up.

Priya: deployment profiles? what would you recommend for Dedicated vs Hosted API?

Maya: short recs: 
- Hosted (latency-sensitive, unpredictable bursts): prefer FP16 or AWQ-int8 for models where AWQ passes quality gates; fallback to GPTQ-4 for lower cost but keep fast-safe fallback to FP16 for flagged prompts.
- Dedicated (reserved capacity): GPTQ-4 is attractive due to cost and predictable throughput; pick Mistral quant profiles with an extra calibration pass and a slightly higher vram headroom (+10%) to avoid tail regressions.
- Private/on-prem: avoid experimental fp8 unless customer has H100 and accepts quality variability.

deploy-bot: can create rollout: canary group size 5% on dedicated pool, auto-roll back on lambada_ppl +2% or mmlu -1.5%. confirm?

Sven: confirm for Llama & Qwen. bump thresholds for Mistral (canary 2%, rollback lambada +1%).

Omar: any outlier cases where GPTQ triggered gross hallucinations?

Maya: small set of prompts (~12 out of 10k) where model produced incoherent repeats under GPTQ-4 for Mistral; our eval harness flagged them as 'repeat-loop' and added to failset. not widespread but worth regression tests.

Priya: action items?

Maya: 
- Omar: run extended seed sweep for fp8 on H100 (3 more seeds) by EOD Thursday.
- Sven: add Mistral per-head calibration run and push updated gptq.toml by Friday.
- Priya: add the 12 repeat-loop prompts to regression suite and gate canary.
- Lee: update deployment playbook with fallback thresholds and memory headroom recs.

Lee: copying notes into the internal eval doc. thanks. :sparkles:

Maya: thanks team. will upload full CSV + perf traces to s3 and link in the eval doc when done.

eval-bot: artifacts: s3://redwood-evals/1807654321/qc-report.csv, traces/, kernel-profiles/ (uploaded)

Sven: great. let's meet Tue to decide final promoted quant profiles.

Maya: added to calendar. end.
